policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Vanguard have conceded twenty-four goals, more than any other programme in the conference, and have scored thirteen; two wins and two draws stand against five defeats.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Point Loma's first home defeat of the season came in conference play, to Hawai'i Pacific.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Hawai'i Hilo's draw at Vanguard on Monday was their first of the season; they have won four and lost three, scoring nine goals and conceding eight.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Hawai'i Pacific's draw at Biola on Monday left them with three wins, three draws and three defeats, and eighteen goals scored against eighteen conceded.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Biola's draw with Hawai'i Pacific on Monday was their third of the season; they have one win and five defeats, and have scored eleven goals and conceded fourteen.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Chaminade have lost all eight matches they have played, scoring five goals and conceding twenty-three.
